title: TR5 Top Load Washer
lead: The TR5 puts Speed Queen's Perfect Wash system behind three dials. Six cycles, four water temperatures, and the same 1 HP motor as the TR7. Backed for five years, parts and labor.

features.name: Speed Queen Perfect Wash
features.line: Speed Queen's wash system for the TR line: an agitator in a stainless steel tub, with each cycle's wash action set for the fabrics it is meant for.

features.name: Quiet at 43 dB
features.line: Rated at 43 dB during agitation, driven by a variable-speed 1 HP motor. The laundry can run while the house carries on.

features.name: Six cycles on a dial
features.line: Heavy Duty, Normal Eco, Perm Press, Delicates, Handwash and Spin Only, chosen with a turn. Four water temperatures and three load sizes, Auto Fill among them.

features.name: Delayed lid lock
features.line: The lid stays unlocked until the first spin, so whatever turned up late can still go in.

features.name: Five years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the TR5 with a 5-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

specs: Delayed: unlocked until the first spin
